data.one_liner: Dart implementation of the Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler algorithm
data.what_it_does: Provides a Scheduler, Card, and ReviewLog classes to manage spaced repetition. It calculates review intervals, retrievability, and handles learning, review, and relearning states.
use_when: You need a custom spaced repetition system in a Dart/Flutter app
You want fine‑grained control over review intervals and retention targets
You prefer a pure Dart solution without external dependencies
avoid_when: You only need a simple flashcard app with default scheduling
You are already using a higher‑level learning library that includes scheduling
strengths: Pure Dart, no native platform code
Fully configurable parameters and learning/relearning steps
weaknesses: Requires manual integration into app logic
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and import fsrs.fsrs; no build_runner or permissions needed
